records.text: Blake Neff wrote that Americans spend less of their income on food than people in any other country.
records.speaker: Blake Neff

appearances.snippet: Blake Neff has a chart. He wrote this. Americans literally spend less of their income on food than any other country on the planet.

verification.notes: The episode records Owens displaying and reading Neff's post. The World Economic Forum chart he shared states that the United States had the lowest listed food share at 6.4%. Updated USDA measures use different denominators and report 9.7% of disposable personal income or 12.9% of household expenditures, so the ranking is measure/year dependent; the statement that Neff wrote and shared the claim is verified.
